company_blurb: Kestrel Labs builds cloud infrastructure and enterprise analytics tools for Nordic and European clients. Known for steady growth and pragmatic engineering, the company balances fast product cycles with strict regulatory standards across four core departments.

departments.culture: Engineering values reliable systems, peer code reviews, and uninterrupted focus blocks. Discussions stay grounded in metrics and benchmarks, with a shared appreciation for automation and clean documentation.

Finance operates on predictable cadences, clean audit trails, and disciplined forecasting. Team members collaborate closely during month-end close while maintaining a calm, detail-oriented atmosphere.

Legal balances thorough risk management with practical business support. Counsel and compliance officers work side by side to review contracts and policies clearly, keeping cross-departmental approvals smooth.
Sales thrives on fast communication, shared pipeline goals, and customer feedback. Account executives and operations staff trade notes constantly, celebrating renewals and refining pitches together.

Janne Salonen leads regional pipeline strategy as sales manager. Energetic and goal-oriented, he motivates the team with celebratory coffee runs after big renewals.
Maria Karjalainen oversees regulatory checklists in Legal as a compliance officer. She approaches complex audits with calm precision and dry humor.
Kaisa Niemi serves as a controller in Finance, reviewing departmental budgets and quarterly forecasts. She speaks plainly and values punctual reporting.
Laura Niemi is a senior engineer tackling backend reliability and deployment pipelines. Always happy to mentor juniors, she brings steady kindness to code reviews.
Joonas Koskinen drafts commercial agreements and advises on licensing in Legal. He communicates with structured clarity and careful attention to precedent.
Riikka Saarinen handles mid-market client relationships in Sales. She loves swapping weekend travel stories before diving into product demos.
Antti Heinonen processes expense audits and accounts payable in Finance. He favors brief messages and predictable workflows.
Pihla Saarinen builds revenue models and variance reports as a Finance analyst. Her wry observations keep late-quarter crunch sessions lighthearted.
Kaisa Lehtonen works alongside leadership as a Finance controller to track capital allocation. She asks direct questions and expects clear numbers.
Joonas Heikkinen writes API integrations and automated tests in Engineering. Enthusiastic about new tooling, he is always eager to pair-program.
Antti Salo monitors data governance standards as a compliance officer in Legal. He writes thorough memos and adheres strictly to company protocol.
Tuomas Salonen reviews vendor certifications and policy updates in Legal. Known for deadpan one-liners, he keeps routine policy reviews moving briskly.
Nea Hamalainen negotiates enterprise contracts as Legal counsel. She builds strong rapport across teams and remembers everyone's birthdays.
Venla Lehtonen advises on intellectual property and corporate governance in Legal. She gives straightforward risk assessments without sugarcoating.

Elina Virtanen manages key Nordic accounts in Sales, building long-term client partnerships. She knows everyone in the office and loves hallway catch-ups.
Emma Rantanen streamlines CRM workflows and territory data in Sales ops. She keeps checklists tight and slack updates short.
